tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa bzhugs/

oṃ na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /srid gsum skye 'jigs med pa'i dngos/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ rlung me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po padma dang*/ /zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni bdud kyi mgor/ /zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa/ /lha yi dbang pos btud pa'i gtso la spyi bo'i phyag 'tshal lo/ / zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa gnyis lhag rgyal ba'i phyag dang stong pa dgu dang me yi tshigs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma sreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pa'i mnan pa'i srid med srid pa mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog mkha' 'dra zhabs g.yas dmar pos 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa/ /lag pa bzhi yis mda' lnga gzhu dang lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin pa mnan/ /g.yon pa dkar pos drag po dkar po gdong gcig mig gsum rig byed lag /rtse gsum thod pa ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pa brdzis la 'dud/ /g.yas brkyang stabs gzhugs bdud dang nyon mongs chung ma gnyis kyang ma bzod par/ /dman pa'i gdong gis 'dzin par byed kyang g.yo med gnas pa rdo rje'i sku/ /gtsug gi nor bu sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan/ /thod skam 'phreng dang thal ba phyag rgya klu rgyal bcu yis brgyan la 'dud/ /dbus dang g.yas g.yon mgrin pa'i mdog ni mu men byu ru kunda mtshungs/ /mdun zhal dbang sngon 'bar ba'i 'od dang g.yas ni nyi ma 'char ka mtshungs/ /g.yon zhal zla 'od rgyab ni gser mtshungs spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs la 'dud/

/g.yas g.yon phrag pa dang po mthon mthing gnyis pa gsum pa dmar dang dkar/ /phrag pa re la dpung pa gnyis gnyis de dag so sor phyag gnyis ldan/ /dpung pa phyag dang bcas pa rnams kyang gang las byung ba phrag pa'i mdog /phyag rnams re re so mo lnga lnga sor gdub ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthe bo'i mdog ni mchog gi gser mtshungs mdzub mo dung dang kunda'i mdog /gung mo padma rā ga ltar dmar ming med gnag cing mthe chung ljang*/ /sor mo re re'ang tshigs gsum dang ldan rtsa ba'i phyogs nas go rim bzhin/ /dus mthu'i sprin dang nyin mor byed 'dra zla ba'i mdog dang ldan la 'dud/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍa ma ru/ / tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra stas g.yas kyi phyag brgyan g.yon pa yang*/ dril bu phub dang kha ṭwāṃ thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ /pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgos brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag ma'i phyag gnyis sdigs mdzub tshul gyis gti mug glang chen pags rlon brgyangs/ /g.yas nag g.yon ser 'chi bdag mgo dang lha min khrag gang thod pa 'dzin/ /stag lpags dang ni rdo rje rgyan ldan bdud rigs brgya yi mgo 'phreng 'chang*/ /sma ra smin ma dbu skra ser zhing ral pa'i cod pan ldan la 'dud/ /'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dpal sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser gyi ri mtshungs bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /gri gug dang bcas phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin zhing 'khyud/ /skra grol skam rlon mgo bo'i 'phreng ldan phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan la 'dud/ /sku mdog mthing ga mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /dus sbyor bzhi tshan gsum dang gnyis tshan drug /bcu gnyis zla ba dag pa'i mgrin pa dpung*/ /zhal bzhi 'gyur med thig le bzhi la 'dud/ /nyer drug phyag ni bshol bcas zla ba'i phyogs/

/de nyid byed por bcas pa'i phyag mtshan te/ /pha rol phyin bcu dag pa'i phyag rgya bcu/ /nyon mongs bdud spangs phyogs gnyis zhabs la 'dud/ /nyi ma'i khyim gcig sku dang zla khyim gcig /zhal ras stong nyid rnam thar spyan gsum ldan/ /mtshan bral smon med phyag dang 'du mi byed//rnam par thar pa'i phyag mtshan 'dzin la 'dud// bcu drug dga' ba sgrib bral chu skyes 'dab/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi 'dab mar nus ma brgyad/ /thabs dang shes rab cang te'u kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs g.yas brkyang stabs/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i rang bzhin rnams la 'dud/ /bar gyi 'dab ma brgyad la thabs kyi dngos/ /kun da ltar dkar thos pa bdud rtsis gang*/ /dngos grub bzhir 'gyur lha tshogs mnyes byed rdzas/ /dga' chen mchod pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar 'khor lo'i dbus kyi chu skyes la/ /bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug yab yum ni/ /nus ma'i tshogs dang mchod yon snod bcas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bde chen 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ /lte bar gri gug 'phreng bas mdzes pa yi/ /nam mkha'i gzhi la ye shes 'khor lo sngo/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor gzhu dbang rga shi dag /mtshams rnams sdig khyim skye ba 'gags la 'dud/ /ye shes khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pas sde'i mtshan gyis btags/ / phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/ /shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /ye shes nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlung gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'khyud la 'dud/ /rlung gi gzhi la sa yi 'khor lo ser/ /lte bar 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa yi/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor srang dang srid pa 'gags/ /mtshams rnams len pa bu mo dag la 'dud/ /sa yi khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pa ta sde'i dag pa can/

/phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/ /shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /dbang chen nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlung gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gro'i 'khyud la 'dud/ /me dkyil gzhi la chu yi 'khor lo dkar/ /lte bar padma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa yi/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor seng ge sred pa dag /mtshams rnams karka tshor ba 'gags la 'dud/ /chu yi khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pa pa sde'i sa bon skyes/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla ba'i dag la 'dud/ /shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /gsher byed nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlung gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'khyud la 'dud/ /chu dkyil gzhi la me yi 'khor lo dmar/ /lte bar nor bu'i 'phreng pas mdzes pa yi/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor 'khrig dang reg pa 'gags/ /mtshams rnams skye mched glang khyim dag la 'dud/ /me yi khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pa ṭa sde'i rdo rjes mtshan/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/ /shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /'bar byed nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlung gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'khyud la 'dud/ /sa yi gzhi la rlung gi 'khor lo nag /lte bar ral gri'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa yi/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor lug dang ming gzugs dag /mtshams rnams nya khyim rnam shes 'gags la 'dud/ /rlung gi khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pa tsa sde'i yi ge gzhan/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/

/shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /g.yo ba'i nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlung gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'khyud la 'dud/ / ye shes gzhi la nam mkha'i 'khor lo ljang*/ /lte bar rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i mdzes pa yi/ phyogs rnams dus sbyor bum pa 'du byed 'gags/ /mtshams rnams chu srin ma rig dag la 'dud/ /nam mkha'i khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma// dpa' bor bcas pa ka sde'i ye shes skyes/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/ /shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /stong pa'i nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ / mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlung gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'khyud la 'dud/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis thun bzhi rnam dag pa/ /mi bdag dur khrod rnams la dbang bsgyur mkhan/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs 'khor lo'i gdan steng du/ /rnam par rol mdzad gtum mo'i tshogs la 'dud/ /rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor mkha' ye brgyad/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral sgo brgyad rnams su bzhugs// 'khor lo bzhi yi steng 'og dang 'brel ba'i/ /phyogs mtshams dur khrod brgyad por spyod la 'dud/ /spyi dang khyad par gnyis ka nam mkha' dang*/ /ye shes khams kyi rang bzhin lha mo rnams/ /sgo khyud bar gyi phyi rol stegs bur bzhugs/ /bar bar dur khrod brgyad po skyong la 'dud/ /ye shes stong pa'i 'khor lo'i steng 'og dang*/ /ha kṣa thung ring sde pa rnams dag pa/ khyab byed khams gnyis dag pa ba yi dngos/ /dus sbyor bzhi dang thun bzhi 'gags la 'dud/ /'khor lo drug dang sgo mtshams gnas pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ma kun gtso mo dang mtshungs shing*/ /mi ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang stabs kyis gnas/ khro zhing thung ba'i sku can rnams la 'dud/ /'khor lo drug gi dpa' bo bzhi bcu brgyad/

/zhal gnyis phyag bzhi rdo rje dril bu dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin g.yon brkyangs stabs kyis sbyor/ /he ru ka dpal rigs las byung la 'dud/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang padma char sprin mdog /nor rgyas dung skyong byu ru'i phung po 'dra/ /mtha' yas rigs ldan kun da'i mdog ltar gsal/ /'jog po pad chen rab tu ser la 'dud/ /phyogs bzhi sgo yi stegs bur 'byung ba la/ /rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /bum pa rdo rje padma nor bu'i phyag /klu chen brgyad ni gtum mos 'khyud la 'dud/ /de ltar lha yi 'khor lo legs mchod dri dang 'phreng ba bdug spos ma/ /snang gsal bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu ma dang sgegs mo bzhad mo sil snyan ma/ /gar dang glu yi sbyor ba la brtson 'dod ma 'dod la rab dga' ma/ /rgyan dang cha byad rnam 'gyur dus mas yid rab 'dzin ma rnams bstod do/ /mdung gi 'bigs dang lhag ma bsregs pa'i ro/ /drag po'i g.yul dang rul ba byis pa gsod/ /rnag gi dri dang sbrul gyis bzung ba dang*/ /kang ke la dang ko la ha la dang*/ /ha ha sgrog dang drag tu rgod pa dang*/ /drag po'i sgra can dang ni pheṭa ka ra/ /'jigs su rung dang 'jigs par byed pa ste/ /dur khrod chen po mtshan ma sna tshogs can/ /shing me chu dang sprin dang grub pa'i rdzas/ /ro dang ro langs bya gcan sogs kyis gang*/ /grub pa mchod pa'i tshogs kyis rab tu khyab/ /dpa' bo'i gnas su gnas pa rnams la 'dud/ khyod ni srid pa gsum las 'das kyang srid pa gsum gyi rnam pa can/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos las 'das kyang brtan dang g.yo ba kun gyi gzugs/ /lus dang dbang po'i sbyor ba spangs kyang rtag tu 'dod chags che la rol/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rtag par dka' ba dus kyi 'khor los bdag skyongs shig /gza' dang drang srong rgyu skar khyim dang cha/ /phyogs skyongs zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma dang*/ ghanṭa karṇa dga' byed nag po che/

/bhṛng gi ṇi sogs 'khor mang rgyal gyur cig /de ltar bstod pas phung po khams sogs gzhan/ /bde gshegs snying po de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /glo bur dri ma'i sbubs las nges grol te/ /srid gsum dang ba mngon du byed gyur cig / ces pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa/ 'don pa bsgyur ba'i tshul 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas cung zad brjod pa'o// //zhus dag sarba maṅga lam/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 394--PAGE 393--PAGE 387-
